name: PixiTween Director S12b: the showrunner (Muse Wonder lead agent, board tools, inbox loop, crew routes)
description: The Muse Wonder showrunner: its backend and router task, prompts, board and history rendering, the nine board tools, the event-driven loop with auto-dispatch and auto-chains, runCrew as the new film entry point, chat and voice into the inbox, the crew HTTP routes, a scripted fake showrunner for offline runs, the restart hook and the live crew script. Workers (S12c) and UI (S12d) are separate PRDs.

readFirst: server/agent/director.ts and server/agent/fake-director.ts (the sequential director this replaces when CREW_ENABLED)
extraGuardrails: The showrunner never calls a timeline tool from server/tools/registry.ts. It only calls the board tools in server/crew/showrunner-tools.ts.
With CREW_ENABLED=false every existing director, chat and films test must pass unchanged.

Shared edits are small and stated: router.ts gains the 'showrunner' task; boot.ts appends one hook; films.ts switches runDirector to runCrew behind CREW_ENABLED; chat.ts routes crew films to the inbox; pricing.ts adds the muse-wonder-1.0 price.
manualGates: MG-2: owner runs `npm run live -- s12-crew` (estimate about $1, ceiling $2), then `--yes`: one crew film on the Coffee Co. brief with the scripted mid-build message 'add a sunset scene after the second one, and warmer light everywhere'. Record wall time, jobs, showrunner turns, cost and whether the new scene is in the final film.

MG-3: owner runs `npm run live -- s12-crew --ab --yes` (estimate about $3): the same brief through the sequential director, the crew with a Spark showrunner and the crew with a Wonder showrunner. Paste the printed table into the PR and docs/hackathon/08-agent-orchestration-review.md section 7.

stories.title: Wonder backend, price and the router's showrunner task
stories.description: As a showrunner loop, I want pickBackend('showrunner') to return Muse Wonder with a Spark fallback so that the lead model is one env key away.
steps: Read server/llm/router.ts, server/llm/spark-backend.ts, server/pricing.ts and design.md section 7 (Wonder error row).

Create server/llm/wonder-backend.ts exporting createWonderBackend({ meta, model }) that returns an LlmBackend with id 'wonder' using the Spark client's /chat/completions path with model SHOWRUNNER_MODEL.
Edit server/pricing.ts: add muse-wonder-1.0 at $4 per 1M input and $20 per 1M output tokens.

Edit server/llm/router.ts: add the task 'showrunner'. pickBackend('showrunner') returns the Wonder backend wrapped so a 5xx, timeout or 429-after-retry falls back to Spark for that call and calls onFallback({ from: 'wonder', to: 'spark', reason }). SHOWRUNNER_MODEL starting with 'muse-spark' returns Spark directly.
Add server/llm/wonder-backend.test.ts and extend server/llm/router.test.ts with fake clients.
acceptance: pickBackend('showrunner').id is 'wonder' with the default env and 'spark' with SHOWRUNNER_MODEL=muse-spark-1.3-contributor
A fake Wonder that throws MetaApiError 503 makes the call return the fake Spark answer and onFallback receives from 'wonder'
priceSpark-style pricing for muse-wonder-1.0 of 8000 in and 1500 out tokens is 0.062 USD

stories.description: As a showrunner, I want a fixed, tested prompt and tool list so that its behaviour is reviewable.
steps: Read design.md sections 6.1 and 6.3.
Create server/crew/prompts.ts exporting SHOWRUNNER_SYSTEM (the exact text of design 6.1) and renderBibleBlock(bible) and renderJobBlock(job) for the builder prompt addition of design 6.4.
Create server/crew/prompts.test.ts: the system prompt contains 'You may call several tools in one turn' and 'Never use real brand names'; renderBibleBlock of the example bible matches a snapshot.

stories.title: Board and inbox rendering with history compaction
stories.description: As a showrunner, I want a compact view of the board and the new inbox items each turn so that turns stay under about 8k input tokens.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.7 and 6.2, shared/crew.ts and server/authoring/api.ts (summariseComposition).

Create server/crew/history.ts exporting renderTurn({ storyboard, rev, jobs, findings, budget, inbox }) producing the BOARD table and NEW IN YOUR INBOX list of design 6.2, and compact(messages, keepTurns = 8, storySoFar) which replaces older turns with one 'STORY SO FAR' message.
Export storySoFar(events) that builds one paragraph from storyboard.revised, showrunner.heard (user) and take.ready events, at most 1200 characters.
Create server/crew/history.test.ts with a fixture event list in fixtures/s12b/events-midbuild.json.
acceptance: renderTurn of 4 scenes and 3 inbox items contains one table row per scene and the line starting '[user ' for the user item
compact() of 12 turns keeps the system message, a STORY SO FAR message and the last 8 turns
The planning turn's image part is removed from every compacted history after turn 1

stories.title: Board tools: setStyleBible and reviseStoryboard
stories.description: As a showrunner, I want to set the style bible and revise the storyboard so that the crew has a plan.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.4 and 6.3, server/crew/storyboard-ops.ts and server/crew/sync.ts.

Create server/crew/showrunner-tools.ts with the CrewCtx type ({ filmId, films, board, scheduler, budget, emit, inbox, source }) and the tools setStyleBible (stores film.styleBible, emits style.bible) and reviseStoryboard (applyOps, then films.mutate with syncComposition, then films.update storyboard and storyboardRev + 1, emits storyboard.revised, returns { rev, needsBuilder, needsMode }).
Create server/crew/showrunner-tools.test.ts with makeTestFilm.
acceptance: reviseStoryboard with 4 add ops on an empty film returns rev 1 and needsBuilder ['s1','s2','s3','s4'] and the composition has 4 scene precomps
reviseStoryboard that would make 7 scenes returns { ok: false } with an error naming the 6-scene limit, and storyboardRev is unchanged
setStyleBible with a palette entry 'red' returns ok false

stories.title: Board tools: dispatch, cancel, pickTake, proposeGenerate
stories.description: As a showrunner, I want to hand jobs to the crew and change my mind so that the film follows the user's direction.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.10, server/crew/scheduler.ts and server/generate/mode.ts (the S7 propose path).

Edit server/crew/showrunner-tools.ts: dispatch (validates kind, sceneId exists unless the kind needs none, takes 2..CREW_TAKES_MAX for kind take; calls scheduler.dispatch; returns jobIds), cancel (scheduler.cancel), pickTake (delegates to an injected takes.pick so S12c fills it), proposeGenerate (calls the S7 mode switch to 'generate' for the scene).
Extend server/crew/showrunner-tools.test.ts.
acceptance: dispatch({ kind: 'build-scene', sceneId: 's9', … }) on a film without s9 returns ok false with error 'unknown scene s9'
dispatch({ kind: 'take', sceneId: 's1', takes: 4 }) returns ok false naming CREW_TAKES_MAX
cancel of a running fake job ends it 'cancelled' and returns ok true

stories.title: Board tools: say, ask, finish with the pass gate
stories.description: As a user, I want the showrunner to talk to me and to declare the film done only when it truly is.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.12 and 6.3 and server/review/rules.ts (runRules).

Edit server/crew/showrunner-tools.ts: say emits showrunner.say kind 'note' (or 'reply' when the turn contained a user item); ask emits kind 'ask' with options; finish refuses while any job is queued, running or awaiting-frames, or runRules reports an error-severity finding, and otherwise sets status 'ready' and emits film.status.
Extend server/crew/showrunner-tools.test.ts.
acceptance: finish with one running job returns ok false with error 'jobs still running: j3'
finish with no jobs and a rules error 'text-off-frame' returns ok false naming that rule
say({ text }) in a turn that included a user item emits showrunner.say with kind 'reply'

stories.title: The event-driven showrunner loop
stories.description: As a crew, I want the showrunner to wake on its inbox, take one turn and act through its tools so that it directs without blocking anyone.
steps: Read design.md sections 3.1 and 5.6, server/crew/inbox.ts and server/agent/build-scene.ts (how a tool-calling turn is run and costed).

Create server/crew/showrunner.ts exporting createShowrunner({ ctx, backend, tools, now }) with run(signal): loop { items = await inbox.drain(); emit crew.agent thinking; one chatWithTools turn with parallelHint; run each call; record ledger cost as model SHOWRUNNER_MODEL; emit agent.turn with backend id; if every call failed, one repair turn; emit crew.agent idle } until finished and idle for CREW_IDLE_END_MS, or signal aborted.
Send the product photo as an image part only in the first turn.
Create server/crew/showrunner.test.ts with makeFakeBackend scripts.
acceptance: A scripted planning turn calling setStyleBible, reviseStoryboard (4 adds) and dispatch x4 leaves 4 jobs on the board after one turn
A turn whose two calls both fail triggers exactly one repair turn, and a second all-failed turn triggers none
Only the first chatWithTools call's messages contain an image_url part
Each turn emits crew.agent 'thinking' then 'idle', and one agent.turn

stories.title: Auto-dispatch and auto-chains
stories.description: As a user, I want the film to keep moving even when the model forgets a step so that a card edit or a finished build always leads somewhere.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.4 (auto-dispatch rule) and 5.5 (auto-chains).

Edit server/crew/showrunner.ts: after each turn, every scene in needsBuilder with no writing job dispatched for it in that turn gets an 'auto' build-scene (new scene) or rebuild-scene job with brief = the scene's intent.

Edit server/crew/run-crew.ts (or create it if US-009 has not run) wiring a board listener: a writing job that ends 'done' queues continuity, then one critique for that scene unless one is queued; job outcomes are pushed to the inbox as { from: 'job' } items with the job summary.
Extend server/crew/showrunner.test.ts.
acceptance: A turn that adds s5 but dispatches nothing leaves one 'auto' build-scene job for s5
A turn that adds s5 and dispatches its build itself leaves exactly one build job for s5
A fake build on s2 ending 'done' queues one continuity and one critique job for s2 and pushes one inbox item

stories.title: runCrew entry point and the films handler switch
stories.description: As a new film, I want to be made by the crew when CREW_ENABLED so that the crew is the default path.
steps: Read server/http/handlers/films.ts, server/agent/director.ts (status handling, product photo) and design.md section 3.1.

Create or complete server/crew/run-crew.ts exporting bindCrew(deps) and runCrew(filmId): build board, scheduler (maxWorkers CREW_MAX_WORKERS, runWorker from an injectable worker registry that S12c fills; default registry marks jobs failed 'no worker'), budget, inbox and showrunner; push the system 'New film' item with the brief; set status planning; resolve when the showrunner loop ends. runCrew never rejects (errors become status failed + an error event).
Edit server/http/handlers/films.ts: when CREW_ENABLED, create the film with crew: true and submit runCrew instead of runDirector. Nothing else changes.
Add server/crew/run-crew.test.ts and extend the films route test for both settings.
acceptance: POST /api/films with CREW_ENABLED=true stores crew: true and the admission run function calls runCrew
With CREW_ENABLED=false the existing films handler tests pass unchanged and runDirector is used
runCrew with a showrunner backend that throws ends with status 'failed' and an error event where 'showrunner', and the promise resolves

stories.title: Chat to a crew film goes to the inbox, never 409
stories.description: As a user, I want to talk to the showrunner while the film builds so that I direct it live.
steps: Read server/http/handlers/chat.ts, server/agent/edit-loop.ts (assertEditable) and design.md section 3.2.

Edit server/http/handlers/chat.ts: if film.crew, push { from: 'user', text: message, selection } to the film's inbox (via an exported getCrewSession(filmId) from run-crew.ts; if no session is running, start one with resume = true), emit showrunner.heard, return 202 { accepted: true, inboxId }. Undo and redo on a crew film with a queued or running job return 409 { error: 'crew_busy' }. Non-crew films keep today's behaviour.
Extend server/http/routes-films-chat.test.ts.
acceptance: POST /chat on a crew film whose status is 'building' returns 202 with an inboxId and emits showrunner.heard before any model call
POST /chat on a non-crew building film still returns 409 film_busy
POST /undo on a crew film with a running job returns 409 crew_busy

stories.title: Crew routes and the boot hook
stories.description: As a UI, I want routes for the board, the event log, card edits, cancel, pick, revert and voice so that the user can direct by hand too.
steps: Read docs/hackathon/06-contracts.md section 7 (the crew routes table), server/boot.ts and server/http/handlers/generate.ts (handler style).

Create server/http/handlers/crew.ts exporting registerCrewRoutes(app, deps): GET /api/films/:id/crew (board, bible, storyboardRev), GET /api/films/:id/log (the event log as a JSON array, no passcode), POST /api/films/:id/storyboard { ops } (user source, applies at once, inbox note), POST /api/films/:id/jobs/:jobId/cancel, POST /api/films/:id/takes/:jobId/pick { takeFilmId }, POST /api/films/:id/scenes/:sceneId/revert, POST /api/films/:id/voice (multipart audio within MAX_UPLOAD_MB, transcribed through deps.meta.transcribe with the product noun as keyword, then treated as a chat message).
Create server/crew/boot.ts exporting registerCrew(ctx) and append it to bootHooks in server/boot.ts (one line).
Add server/http/handlers/crew.test.ts.
acceptance: GET /api/films/:id/log returns the film's events in seq order and needs no passcode
POST /storyboard with a camera update on s2 returns 200 with the new rev and makes no model call
POST /scenes/s1/revert with no earlier done job on s1 returns 409 nothing_to_revert
POST /voice with a 1 KB text/plain body returns 415

stories.title: Scripted fake showrunner for offline runs and e2e
stories.description: As a tester, I want a crew film to run end to end with no network so that the Playwright flow and the demo rehearsal are repeatable.
steps: Read server/agent/fake-director.ts (isFakeDirector, delays) and server/crew/showrunner.ts.

Create server/crew/fake-showrunner.ts: when isFakeDirector(), runCrew uses a scripted backend: the planning turn (bible, 4 scenes, 4 dispatches), a reply turn to any user message containing 'scene' that adds one scene after s2 and dispatches restyles for done scenes, a turn that answers critic findings with one fix, then finish. Workers use the existing fake director parts with a per-job delay so 4 builders are visibly busy together.
Add server/crew/fake-showrunner.test.ts running a whole fake crew film with makeTestFilm.
acceptance: A fake crew film ends 'ready' with 4 scenes and at least 4 build jobs whose running intervals overlap
Sending 'add a sunset scene after scene 2' mid-build ends with 5 scenes and s5 third in the storyboard
The fake run records zero Meta HTTP requests

stories.title: Restart hook for interrupted crew films
stories.description: As a owner, I want a server restart to leave crew films honest so that no job shows 'running' forever.
steps: Read server/http/film-queue-install.ts (the requeue boot hook) and server/crew/persist.ts.

Edit server/crew/boot.ts: on boot, for each crew film with a board.json, mark running and awaiting-frames jobs failed with error 'restart', queued jobs cancelled, emit an error event where 'crew.restart', and leave the film's status as 'ready' if it has a composition, else 'failed'.
Extend server/crew/boot.test.ts.
acceptance: A board.json with one running and one queued job becomes one 'failed' (error 'restart') and one 'cancelled' after the hook
A crew film with a composition ends status 'ready' after the hook; one without ends 'failed'

stories.title: Live crew script with the A/B mode

Create scripts/live/s12-crew.ts: describe(), estimateUsd() returning 1 (3 with --ab), run(args): start a crew film on fixtures/seed's product photo with the Coffee Co. brief, send the mid-build chat message 6 s after the first job starts, wait for ready, then print wall time, showrunner turns, jobs by kind, superseded jobs, first-try tool validity, findings and cost from the event log. With --ab also run CREW_ENABLED=false and SHOWRUNNER_MODEL=muse-spark-1.3-contributor and print the 08 section 7 table.
Add scripts/live/s12-crew.test.ts for the table printer using fixtures/s12b/events-midbuild.json.

The table printer over the fixture log prints a 'Wall time' row and a 'Cost per film' row with values taken from the log
